result.summary:
All commands run synchronously in the foreground (git commit c060a0d0c5ee8bba759bc301ad7cc6e7d1db9fa6, branch fix/ISS-0398-walk-to-gateway-20260901). The mix letflow.check.test full-suite run took ~23 minutes and exceeded the single-Bash-call 10-minute cap; it was polled to completion via repeated foreground Bash calls tailing its own captured log file -- never backgrounded via run_in_background/Monitor, and the turn was never ended to await a cross-turn notification.

1. `mix test test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs` -- `Result: 12 passed`, `Finished in 0.6 seconds`. 12/12 confirmed.

2. `mix test test/letflow/scheduler_req188_test.exs` -- `Result: 8 passed`, `Finished in 5.6 seconds`. 8/8 confirmed (REVIEWER's guard-test rescoping still green).

3. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -- exit 0, no output (clean compile, zero warnings).

4. `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` -- 23 files changed, 2695 insertions(+), 58 deletions(-), scope matches exactly what was expected: lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex, lib/letflow/design/iss0398-walk-to-gateway-fix.md, test/letflow/engine/parallel_gateway_test.exs, test/letflow/scheduler_req188_test.exs, test/specs/ISS-0398.md, test/specs/REQ-188.md, plus this run's handoffs/registry.json/orchestrator.log. No unrelated files touched.

5. `mix letflow.check.test` (full suite, both the default run and the wasm_hang-only run folded into one mix task invocation) -- `Result: 3006/3008 passed (6/6 properties, 3000/3002 tests), 10 excluded` / `Failed: 2 tests` / `Finished in 1382.2 seconds (14.0s async, 1368.1s sync)`, then `** (Mix) mix letflow.check.test: FAILED -- underlying mix test run exited 2 (real test failure/error)`.

The 2 failures are BOTH in Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest (test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs:274 and :289, the REQ-165 rust-pin checker tests), both `** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent` from `System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"], ...)` at lib/system.ex:1141. Confirmed via `which rustc cargo` that this sandbox has NO Rust toolchain installed at all -- this is a pre-existing environment gap (parallel to README.md's already-documented `mix deps.get` no-network-access gap), not a regression from this diff. That test file is absent from the diff --stat above, and neither transition.ex nor the two touched test files have anything to do with the Rust/NIF toolchain-pin checker. Not silently patched: fixing it would mean installing rustc into this sandbox (infra, out of scope) or weakening REQ-165's own toolchain-pin test (would defeat its purpose) -- flagging explicitly rather than waving through.

Full structured report written to test/reports/report-2026-09-01-WF03-ISS0398-20260901.yaml with every count/error quoted verbatim, per no-speculation rule.
